title: Histological Observation of Tissues
author: Honghao Zhao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.smfec3n

steps.title: Collect muscle and gonad tissues
steps.instruction: Harvest white muscle and gonad tissues from 250 tails per experimental group (AF and GF).

steps.title: Store muscle samples in fixative
steps.instruction: Place each white muscle sample from GF and AF groups into tissue fixative for temporary storage.

steps.title: Fix gonad samples in Bouin's
steps.instruction: Collect 500 gonad samples per experimental fish, place each in a 2 mL plastic tube containing Bouin's fixative, and keep at 4 °C.

steps.title: Freeze back and abdominal muscles
steps.instruction: Immediately harvest back and abdominal muscle samples, freeze them in liquid nitrogen, then transfer and store at –80 °C until Oil Red O staining.

steps.title: Section tissues at 10 µm thickness
steps.instruction: Prepare serial transverse sections of 10 µm thickness from both frozen muscle and fixed gonad tissues.

steps.title: Stain sections with H&E
steps.instruction: Routinely stain the 10 µm sections of muscle and gonad with hematoxylin & eosin (H&E).

steps.title: Stain muscle with Oil Red O
steps.instruction: Stain frozen muscle sections with Oil Red O solution to visualize any fat present in the muscle.

steps.title: Determine fish sex histologically
steps.instruction: Identify the sex of each grass carp by examining the contour of the gonad and the corresponding histological slice.

steps.title: Assign samples to sex‑diet groups
steps.instruction: Based on sex determination, categorize muscle samples into four groups (n = 10 each): female grass‑feeding (FGF), male grass‑feeding (MGF), female artificial‑diet (FAF), and male artificial‑diet (MAF).

steps.title: Measure muscle fiber cross‑sectional area
steps.instruction: Using a Leica MZ 6 microscope, examine 200–400 muscle fibers per experimental group, measuring cross‑sectional area and including only fibers with diameters ≥10 µm.
